# SANAD-Gabès — evaluation report

*Fictional process plant in the Gabès industrial zone. All parameters are simulation assumptions. No measurement originates from a real company.* Generated by `python -m sanad.cli evaluate` for run `main` (config `configs/default.yaml`, seed 20261015). Every number below is computed by the code.

## Protocol

Time-block split (config-driven), embargo of 24 h at the start of each later block (no events placed, no cases scored):

| Block | From (UTC) | To (UTC) | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| normal | 2025-06-02 00:00 | 2025-06-16 00:00 | fit Stage A (normalisation, thresholds, Isolation Forest) |
| train | 2025-06-17 00:00 | 2025-06-30 00:00 | rule/threshold development (in-sample) |
| val | 2025-07-01 00:00 | 2025-07-14 00:00 | isotonic confidence calibration |
| test | 2025-07-15 00:00 | 2025-07-28 00:00 | held-out evaluation (headline) |

Event-level scoring: an injected event is *detected* if a case overlaps it (event window + 60 min tolerance, compatible equipment). Its *predicted class* is the verdict of the first matched case that did not abstain; UNCERTAIN if all matched cases abstained; MISSED if none matched. Precision is case-level. Normal motor starts are not anomalies: a case on one counts as a false positive.

## Confidence calibration (validation block)

Method: isotonic on 42 validation cases (shrunk toward the raw score with a 20-case prior). Top-hypothesis accuracy on validation: 97.6%; ECE before: 0.146, after (in-sample): 0.000.

## Known limitations

- Synthetic data only; the detector was developed on the same simulator family, so these numbers are an upper bound for real data.
- 1-min resolution: GRID_SAG is a sustained under-voltage (>= 1 min); inrush appears as a 1-min average.
- Compound events (real overload during a meter CT drift) are scored like single events; the overload inside a drift episode is usually reported as part of the drift case.
- AUX1 has a single meter; meter/energy hypotheses on AUX1 abstain by design (too few redundant paths).
